chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Jamil ibn Darraj, from one of our companions, from one of the two (Imams) (peace be upon him), regarding the man who divorces the young girl who has not yet reached the age of bearing children, and he had consummated the marriage with her; and the woman who has despaired of menstruation, and her menstruation has ceased, so she cannot bear children. He (peace be upon him) said: 'There is no waiting period upon them, even if he had consummated the marriage with them both.'
Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Hadeed, from Jamil ibn Darraj, from one of our companions, similar to it.
ai.seo_question: What is the waiting period for a divorced pre-pubescent girl or menopausal woman in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith clarifies the fiqh of 'iddah by distinguishing between the general rule of three menstrual cycles and the specific exception for those who do not menstruate, a principle derived from Surah At-Talaq. It highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on the physiological state of the woman—specifically the cessation or absence of menstruation—as the primary determinant for the waiting period, even in cases of consummated marriage with pre-pubescent or menopausal women.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel Bin Darraj, from one of our companions, 
(It has been narrated) from one of the two (5th or 6th Imam<sup>asws</sup>) regarding the man who divorces the child who has yet to mature and the likes of her cannot get pregnant, and he had slept with her; and the woman who has despaired from the menstruation (in menopause), and her menstruation are lifted, so she cannot give birth. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no waiting period upon her, even if he has slept with them both’.
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Hadeed, from Jameel Bin Darrah,f rom one of our companions – similar to it.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Jamil ibn Darraj from certain persons of our people who has said the following: “There is the case of a man who divorces a girl who is not mature yet and the like of whom cannot become pregnant, but he has gone to bed with her and a woman after menopause when women of her condition cannot give birth. One of the two Imam, (abu Ja‘far or abu ‘ Abd Allah), ‘Alayhim al-Salam, has said, ‘There is no waiting period for them.’”
Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Hadid from Jamil ibn Darraj from certain persons of our people a similar Hadith.
